question: What is the name of the official mascot for the Khelo India Para Games 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ujjwala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The official mascot for the Khelo India Para Games 2025 is named **Ujjwala**.
 
• The name "Ujjwala" signifies **brightness, empowerment, and inclusion**, reflecting the spirit of the Paralympic Games and the athletes participating in them.
 
• The Khelo India Para Games is an initiative under the **Khelo India programme**, aimed at promoting sports culture and inclusivity in India.
 
• The mascot symbolizes the **resilience and determination** of para-athletes who overcome challenges to achieve excellence in sports.
 
• The Khelo India initiative, including the Para Games, is part of the broader mission of the government to **encourage sports participation** among all sections of society, including differently-abled individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Veera**

 
 
• "Veera" often symbolizes **bravery and courage**. While this name could represent the indomitable spirit of athletes, it is not the correct mascot for the Khelo India Para Games 2025.
 
• It could be used in other contexts or events to symbolize heroic achievements or the courage of participants.
 
 
 
• **Shakti**
 
 
• "Shakti" translates to **power or energy** and represents strength, often associated with women's empowerment or dynamic energy.
 
• While a strong and meaningful name, it is not the mascot for the Khelo India Para Games 2025, but could be suitable for initiatives related to power or dynamic growth.
 
 
 
• **Lakshya**
 
 
• "Lakshya" means **goal or target**, representing determination and ambition.
 
• Though this name aligns with the concept of achieving goals, it is not the name of the official mascot for the Khelo India Para Games 2025.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Programme**
 
 
• Launched in 2018 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, the Khelo India programme aims to **revive the sports culture in India**.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Para Games 2025**:
 
 
• The** 2nd edition** of the Khelo India Para Games (KIPG) 2025 took place in New Delhi from **March 20–27, 2025**.
 
• Over 1,300 athletes from 36 States and Union Territories competed in six sports disciplines, namely:
 
 
• Para Athletics
 
• Archery
 
• Badminton
 
• Table Tennis
 
• Power Lifting
 
• Shooting
 
 
 
• **State-wise medals tally**:
 
 
• Haryana: 104 medals (34 Gold)
 
• Tamil Nadu: 74 medals (28 Gold)
 
• Uttar Pradesh: 64 medals (23 Gold)
 
• Rajasthan: (22 Gold)
